issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation renders 'εαν ποιητε αυτα' (if you do these things) as 'nếu các ngươi làm theo' (if you follow/do along). While 'làm theo' can mean 'do', it often implies 'following' or 'obeying' a command. However, the Greek 'ποιητε' is the simple imperative/indicative of 'doing' the things mentioned. More importantly, the Vietnamese structure 'thì có phước' (then [you] have blessing) slightly shifts the conditional flow, though the main issue is the slight nuance shift from 'do these things' to 'follow [them]'.
